SELECT s.id, s.title, s.description, s.price, s.category, s.images, s.condition, s.status, s.seller_id, s.view_count, s.create_time, u.username as seller_name FROM secondhand s LEFT JOIN user u ON s.seller_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT goods_id, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM goods_favorite GROUP BY goods_id ) gf ON gf.goods_id = s.id
s.status = 'APPROVED' AND (s.deleted = 0 OR s.deleted IS NULL)
AND s.category = #{category}
AND (s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY ( IFNULL(gf.favorite_count, 0) * 6 + LEAST(IFNULL(s.view_count, 0), 300) * 0.08 + CASE s.`condition` WHEN 'NEW' THEN 8 WHEN 'LIKE_NEW' THEN 5 WHEN 'GOOD' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END + GREATEST(0, 30 - TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY, s.create_time, NOW())) * 0.6 + CASE WHEN COALESCE(#{keyword}, '') != '' AND s.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 8 WHEN COALESCE(#{keyword}, '') != '' AND s.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 ELSE 0 END ) DESC, s.create_time DESC
ORDER BY s.price ASC
ORDER BY s.price DESC
ORDER BY s.create_time DESC
LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
